purpose: Conservative tracked-evidence split for citation-network publications with multiple experiments or profile variants. Suffixes are display labels only; record_id and profile_id remain immutable join keys. A blank record_id means that no experiment-specific audit record exists and evidence must not be inherited from a neighboring experiment.

corpus_freeze.scope: Audiotactile PPS publications in the existing dated 94-publication map, with explicit unresolved identity and adjacent-family boundaries. This is a bounded corpus audit, not an exhaustive literature claim.
corpus_freeze.platform_scope: Windows first; hosted prepare/preview only; native qualification requires separate observed evidence.
corpus_freeze.deferred_scope: Broader human PPS families outside audiotactile experiments; no automatic new literature expansion.
corpus_freeze.authority_rule: Publication metadata coverage, experiment inventory, reviewed parameters, template availability, and physical qualification remain independent.
completion_criteria: Every frozen publication has a source-backed experiment inventory or a dated audited source-access gap; current unassessed placeholders do not count as reviewed.

Each in-scope experiment has an eleven-contract disposition with primary-source section/page evidence, component review and derivations where applicable; partial, conflicting or approximation states may remain only as explicit bounded gaps.
An inaccessible-source disposition records actual retrieval routes, dates and outcomes; not_assessed is never silently converted to source_unavailable.
Boundary records retain identity conflicts and scientific exclusion reasons separately from DOI or map eligibility. A newly resolved candidate requires an explicit corpus-version decision.
Public projection regenerates deterministically, preserves stable IDs, excludes private sources, and never upgrades evidence from defaults, templates or native implementation labels.
Science audit sign-off reports remaining gaps and does not imply that any preset or physical route is qualified.

foundational_lineage_check.selection_rule: One-hop check of the four named primary reference lists for human empirical auditory-tactile spatial/PPS paradigms or auditory-PPS motor antecedents published through 2012. Select references explicitly introduced as spatial paradigms or motor antecedents; do not recursively snowball.
foundational_lineage_check.exclusions: General audiovisual or visuotactile, animal, review/theory, auditory-only, general temporal/loudness integration without an identified spatial PPS manipulation, and post-2012 references are outside this foundational check. These are check boundaries, not blanket scientific exclusions from future corpus versions.
